title: Consolidation: The Blue Danube: Ecology, Dams & Civic Awakening

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can recount the history of Hungarian river engineering, the 1980s Duna Kör movement, Lake Balaton's preservation, and the 2000 Tisza cyanide spill.
I can use formal causal (következtében, folytán, hatására, révén) and purposive postpositions (érdekében, végett, elkerülése végett).
I can say why many experts now prefer water retention to quick drainage.
I can use the environmental policy, ecology and water management words of this unit.
